_note: Outside tools the app links to. Re-check every URL before the demo and update last_checked.

resources.name: Have I Been Trained (Spawning)
resources.what_it_does: Search public training datasets for your images and mark them as opted out.

resources.name: Spawning: Do Not Train registry
resources.what_it_does: Register works you don't want used for AI training. Only AI developers who choose to check the registry are affected.

resources.name: Glaze (University of Chicago)
resources.what_it_does: Adds changes to your image meant to disrupt style mimicry by AI models. Runs on your own computer.

resources.name: Nightshade (University of Chicago)
resources.what_it_does: Alters images so that models trained on them without consent learn distorted features.

resources.name: Dark Visitors (AI crawler list)
resources.what_it_does: Lists known AI crawlers and generates robots.txt rules to block them on your own website.
